stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Can the laptop keep the cedar count?
stations.note: She crosses out a sticky note.

stations.title: Shelf count
stations.text: One number that follows every sale.

captions: The parcel note prints. Next, Ines wants the laptop to keep the cedar count.
The count lives on a sticky note, crossed out after every sale.
You keep it in variables instead, in four small tasks.
Now the count starts with the delivery and follows each sale.
Values under good names: the laptop remembers, and anyone can read it.
